subject: differences in selectInput(multiple = TRUE) locally and on glimmer server

messages.author: c81ff89dde81dce8
messages.subject: differences in selectInput(multiple = TRUE) locally and on glimmer server
parts: Was there a recent change to the glimmer server that affected the functionality of selectInput(multiple = TRUE)? I've attached images of the UI differences for an app run locally and run on glimmer. The difference is not simply aesthetic; clicking on the selectInput widget in glimmer does not have any effect.

messages.author: 2955fcac6ef9e99d
messages.subject: Re: differences in selectInput(multiple = TRUE) locally and on glimmer server
parts:
The Glimmer.png image that you attached is consistent with glimmer using the newer (development/github) version of shiny. The github version appears to use the selectize.js (http://brianreavis.github.io/selectize.js/) version of the selectInput widget. Shiny 0.8 gives behavior like that of your Local.png image.

Kevin

messages.author: c81ff89dde81dce8
messages.subject: Re: differences in selectInput(multiple = TRUE) locally and on glimmer server
parts: Thanks, Kevin. I was under the impression that glimmer uses the CRAN version of shiny, but I guess that I was mistaken on that point. I'm also embarrassed to admit that there is no problem with the functionality of the selectInput widget on glimmer. I just didn't realize that you delete the boxes with options that you want to exclude. My first reaction to that (newer) interface was to try to select options by clicking on the boxes. Thanks again for pointing me in the right direction.

parts:
Sorry for the confusion. Kevin was correct -- we were rolling out
shiny 0.9.0 and preparing a CRAN release. An announcement calling for
testing of shiny 0.9 will come soon. We will love to hear your
feedback (selectizeInput() was one of the major new features).

Regards,
Yihui
